issues.problem: h2 max 38.4px is only 5.6px below h1 44px.
issues.fix: Set h2 { font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 2.6vw, 2rem); } so desktop h2 is 32px.

issues.problem: font-stretch 112% stacked with negative tracking pinches sidebearings.
issues.fix: Keep font-stretch 112%. Set h2,h3 letter-spacing to 0; h1 to -0.01em; .mark to 0.
